title: MCPTracer assert --spec --json output (v1)
description: Output of `mcptracer assert <session-id> --spec <spec.toml> --json` -- a bare JSON array, not an object. `assert --golden --json` emits diff-report.v1.schema.json instead, not this schema. Bump the filename version and add a new schema on any breaking change; do not edit this file in place once published.

description.description: Human description of the rule, e.g. 'tool_called echo'.

reason.description: Failure reason; null when passed is true.
